resources.string: Sending recordings to the AI provider

A recording is sent to the AI provider only to answer a request, such as pronunciation feedback or spoken practice. Recordings stay on this device otherwise. Consent can be withdrawn at any time; offline listening drills keep working.
Show Hangul beside pinyin as an optional reading aid. Pinyin with tone numbers always stays visible.
Practice history, transcripts, cached audio, and recordings are stored on this device. Deleting removes them and resets settings to their defaults. This cannot be undone.
